findings.title: Capabilities column lacks truncation at narrow widths
findings.problem: The capabilities colgroup stays fixed at 14% (line 148) and the capability pill <span> (lines 210-215) has no truncate/ellipsis styling. The spec explicitly called for verifying/widening this column for the two-tag case at the narrower call site, but the diff only changed the flex direction (flex-col to flex-nowrap) and did not address width or per-pill truncation.
findings.impact: At narrow viewport widths (e.g. the ProjectMemberModelOverrideModal popup, which can render below its max-w-6xl cap), two capability tags such as "multimodal" + "tools" may not fit in the 14% column. Because the td already has overflow-hidden and the pills no longer wrap, an overflowing tag is hard-clipped mid-character instead of truncating gracefully, leaving the acceptance criterion on tag/text overlap only partially satisfied.
findings.recommendation: Add truncate/text-ellipsis styling to the capability <span>, and check at both call sites (full-width ProjectModelsSection.tsx and the narrower ProjectMemberModelOverrideModal.tsx popup) whether the 14% capabilities colgroup width needs widening, adjusting the Cost column proportionally if so.
